title: Handles — Sturij
description: The part you hold: Hendel & Hendel handles in fifteen finishes, with weight in the hand and a finish that stays right.

standfirst.text: A handle is the one piece of your furniture you'll touch every day. It should have weight in the hand and a finish that stays right for years. We fit Hendel & Hendel.

lines.text: Hendel & Hendel design their handles in Britain, and they design them to be held: solid, weighty, with textures you notice — ribbed, reeded, hammered — and a palette of finishes broad enough to sit with any decor on this site and the taps and lighting already in the room.

Brass in five moods, nickel in four, bronze, pewter, chrome, anodised, matt black. Compose a swatch in the range with the handle finish you're drawn to and the room visual follows it — the same finish sits in the drawing and comes to the design visit as a sample.
These are solid handles, not hollow ones. The difference is obvious the first time you open a wardrobe door, and it doesn't wear off.
Precise threads and proper fixings, so the handle sits square and stays tight.
Backplates on the ranges where a plate makes for a cleaner line.
Hendel & Hendel guarantee their handles for life.
Pick the finish you keep coming back to. We'll bring it with us.

faq.q: Which handle finishes can I choose from?

a.text: Fifteen, shown in the range on this site — several brasses and nickels, bronze, pewter, chrome, anodised and matt black. Compose a swatch with the one you like and it comes with your enquiry.

faq.q: Will the finish match my taps and lights?

a.text: Usually, yes — the palette is broad enough to sit with the common tap and light finishes. Bring a photo or the tap's finish name to the design visit and we'll put the sample beside it.

faq.q: Can I mix finishes in one room?

a.text: Yes, deliberately: a brass handle on a dark door with matt-black lighting profiles can look considered. We'd rather show you the combination with the samples than describe it.
They do — Hendel & Hendel's handles are solid and weighty, which is most of what "quality" means when you're holding a handle.
Hendel & Hendel guarantee their handles for life; our own warranty covers the fitting.

faq.q: Can I have no handles at all?

a.text: Yes — handleless doors with push-to-open, or a routed grip in the door edge. See the hardware section.
